segments.name: Sand and Logistics
segments.description: Mines and sells proppant sand and runs logistics for oil and gas producers in the Permian Basin.
segments.evidence: Segments Sand and Logistics We operate 14 proppant production facilities across the Permian Basin including both large-scale in-basin facilities and smaller distributed mining units.

segments.name: Power
segments.description: Provides distributed power generation to oil and gas production and artificial lift operations.
segments.evidence: Power We provide distributed power solutions through a fleet of natural gas-powered reciprocating generators primarily supporting production and artificial lift operations across major United States resource basins.

revenueModel.text: Oil and gas producers buy proppant sand, logistics and distributed power in the Permian Basin.
revenueModel.evidence: We operate a differentiated logistics platform that is designed to increase the efficiency, safety and sustainability of the oil and natural gas industry primarily within the Permian Basin.
